chunks: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot

key_terms.لُوطٍ: Lot, the prophet and nephew of Abraham

ai.seo_question: Who are the people of Abraham and Lot mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this segment highlights the parallel fates of the people of Abraham and Lot, emphasizing their distinct yet related experiences of divine trial and ultimate destruction due to their rejection of prophetic truth. The mention serves as a reminder of the consistency of Allah's judgment across different generations, reinforcing the theme of *adl* (divine justice) where the righteous are preserved while the corrupt are eradicated. This pairing often underscores the continuity of the prophetic mission and the universal nature of the call to monotheism.
